entries.category_description: Medical equipment, aids and other appliances normally intended to alleviate or treat disability, for the exclusive personal use of the disabled, including the repair of such goods
entries.comment:
This reduced rate applies only to aids for the deaf, blind and visually impaired persons (part 1):
— monuculars, binocular glasses; 9004 90 90
— magnifying glasses; 9013 80 00
— magnifying video systems and reading monitors; 8528 and 8543
— White canes; 6602 00 00
— handles and knobs of a white cane; 6603 90 10
— parts and accessories for white cane; 6603 90 90 —
Alarm clocks for deaf and blind persons (tactile, speaking, vibrating); 9105 11 00 and 9105 19 00
